_doc: Ash's fullness (hunger.gd), 0..100 %. It empties by drain_per_hour per game hour standing about, times activity[...] walking, running, riding his bike or wading. kcal_per_pct: the calories (food.json kcal) that fill 1 % (100 % = 1600 kcal, a hungry boy's day between meals). levels: the fullness at which each level starts (stuffed at 92 and up; full 70..92 is Well fed; satisfied 45..70 nothing; peckish 28..45; hungry 12..28; starving under 12): the effects are in life/conditions.json (hungry's levels, well_fed, stuffed). start: a new game's fullness. growl: seconds (real) between tummy growls while hungry / starving, tummy_hand: the chance one comes with his hand on his tummy (standing still). eat: the eating moment, seconds a bite (bite_s) and bites per 10 game minutes of the item's minutes (bites_per_10, between bites_min and bites_max).
